_comment: A planet's type is its texture's name: file="planets/agricultural.png" -> agricultural; jump points (jump.ani) are "jump".
"planets" entries (by planet name, e.g. New_Detroit) win over "types"; a "*" type applies to every other planet.
An entry can be false for no halo. Fields left out come from "defaults":
thickness  atmosphere height, as a fraction of the planet's radius
falloff    scale height of the air, as a fraction of the thickness (small: thin sharp rim, large: deep even haze)
density    how opaque the air is (raise it for smog)
night      brightness of the unlit side, 0..1
glow       true: only adds light (glows, e.g. round jump points); false: air that also veils what is behind it
